title: Exit 10, Inc., doing business as SouthOrd, Secures GSA Multiple Award Schedule Contract with the Help of Government Marketplace LLC | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
With the support of Government Marketplace LLC, SouthOrd secures GSA Schedule contract to expand federal access to premium U.S.-made locksmith tools.
LONGWOOD, Fla. - April 16, 2025 - PRLog -- Exit 10, Inc., doing business as SouthOrd , a leading U.S. manufacturer of professional locksmith tools, is proud to announce it has been awarded a GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) Contract by the U.S. General Services Administration. This significant milestone— GSA Contract #47QSMS25D0064 —will allow SouthOrd to expand its reach and deliver high-quality, American-made locksmith tools to federal agencies across the nation.
This achievement was made possible through the dedicated support and guidance of Mr. Steven Stone and the expert team at Government Marketplace LLC , who provided invaluable assistance throughout the application and approval process.
Founded in 1989, SouthOrd has evolved from a small catalog-based business into a globally respected name in the locksmithing industry. Since introducing its own line of lock picks in 1991, SouthOrd has continually led the way in innovation and quality. From pioneering rivetless, spot-welded handle designs to introducing high-performance stainless steel picks and the iconic JPXS-6 Jackknife Lock Pick Set , SouthOrd remains at the forefront of professional locksmith tools.
SouthOrd's toolsets, including its MAX series , Electric Lock Picks , and Tubular Lock Picks , are trusted by professionals worldwide. Manufactured in the U.S. from premium stainless steels, every tool undergoes an extensive finishing process to ensure superior performance and longevity.
"Being awarded a GSA Schedule contract is not just a win for SouthOrd," said a company spokesperson. "It's a testament to over three decades of hard work, innovation, and our unwavering commitment to quality. We are grateful to Mr. Steven Stone and the Government Marketplace team for helping us make this a reality."
With the GSA Schedule contract in place, federal, state, and local government agencies can now easily procure SouthOrd products through the GSA Advantage platform, simplifying the purchasing process and ensuring access to tools manufactured with precision, integrity, and care.
For more information about SouthOrd, or to inquire about their full range of locksmith tools now available on the GSA Schedule, please contact:
